units.source_text: 《伊势物语》是以诗歌为中心的歌物语，作于平安时代。

en.t: The Tales of Ise is a poem-centered uta monogatari, or tale built around poems, and was composed in the Heian period.

units.source_text: 内容凡百二十五则，大都叙述男女爱情。

en.t: It contains one hundred twenty-five episodes in all, most of which describe love between men and women.

units.source_text: 据说是以在原业平所作歌稿为中心而编成的。

en.t: It is said to have been compiled chiefly around draft poems composed by Ariwara no Narihira.

units.source_text: 在原业平是平安初期的歌人。

en.t: Ariwara no Narihira was a poet of the early Heian period.

units.source_text: 是六歌仙之一，又是三十六歌仙之一。

en.t: He was one of the Six Poetic Immortals and also one of the Thirty-Six Poetic Immortals.
He was also known by the name Zaigo Chujo.

units.source_text: 故《伊势物语》又名《在五物语》《在五中将日记》。

en.t: For this reason, The Tales of Ise is also known as The Tales of Zaigo and The Diary of Zaigo Chujo.

units.source_text: 此书对后世日本文学影响甚大。

en.t: This book had a very great influence on later Japanese literature.
